name: Honda CBR600RR
engine: 599 cc liquid-cooled inline four, fuel injected
intro: Honda's 600 supersport. The charging system and a fuel pump recall are the big things to check.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Certain 2007 and 2009-2012 CBR600RRs are in recall 24V864 for a fuel pump impeller that can deform. Book any open recall with a Honda dealer.
A-002.reason: A failing fuel pump can stall the bike. The repair is free.

F-002.title: Test the charging system
F-002.instructions: With a charged battery, measure voltage at the battery at idle and at higher rpm. If it's low or high, test the regulator/rectifier and the stator.
F-002.reason: The regulator/rectifier on these bikes can overheat and fail, leaving a dead battery.

recalls.what: Fuel pump impeller can deform, causing a no-start or stall.

known.title: Regulator/rectifier
known.what: Can overheat and burn out, killing the battery.
